chunks: Then their excuse will be but to say: 'By God our Lord, we were not idolaters.'
ai.seo_question: What was the excuse of the polytheists on the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Day of Resurrection when the polytheists will offer their final verbal excuse, claiming they were not true idolaters but merely followed their forefathers in ignorance. The term 'fitnah' here signifies their trial or the pretext they present, which God will ultimately reject as insufficient justification for their shirk. This highlights the transition from mere verbal denial to the reality of their deeds being weighed against their claims.
